The structure of Sm3Au9Bi3 (reduced formula SmAu3Bi) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with 15 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Au centers with 11 geometric neighbors (5 Au, 3 Bi, 3 Sm), Bi centers with 9 Au neighbors, and Sm centers with 12 Au neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 15 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations indicate corner, edge, and face sharing between Au 11-vertex polyhedra, corner and edge sharing between Au and Bi 9-vertex polyhedra, and corner and face sharing between Au and Sm 12-vertex polyhedra.
